∀ {M P F A : Type} (memory : Itasca.runtime.platform.MemoryBuffer M) (hooks : Itasca.runtime.platform.Platform P M)
  (floats : Itasca.runtime.platform.FloatOps F) (allocator : Itasca.runtime.platform.Alloc A)
  (view : M → Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8)
  (Inv : Itasca.Representation.CodeInterpretation → Itasca.runtime.store.Store M → Prop),
  Itasca.Integration.InstantiationContract view Inv →
    Itasca.Platform.MemoryLaws memory view →
      Itasca.Platform.AllocCorrect allocator →
        ∀ (before : Itasca.runtime.store.Store M) (module : Itasca.runtime.compiler.ExecutableModule)
          (imports : Aeneas.Std.Slice Itasca.runtime.Extern) (platform : P)
          (oldCode : Itasca.Representation.CodeInterpretation),
          Inv oldCode before →
            (∀ external ∈ ↑imports, Itasca.Store.ExternalIssued before external) →
              ∀ (bytes : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (limits : Itasca.runtime.compiler.CompileLimits),
                Itasca.runtime.compiler.compile_with allocator bytes limits =
                    Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok module) →
                  ∀ (raw : Itasca.Binary.Module),
                    Itasca.Binary.ModuleEncodingWith Itasca.CodeEntry.CodeEncoding raw ↑bytes →
                      Module_ok (Itasca.Module.Elaboration.moduleOf raw) ∧
                        Aeneas.Std.WP.spec
                          (Itasca.runtime.store.instantiate.Store.instantiate_with memory hooks floats allocator before
                            module imports platform)
                          (Aeneas.Std.uncurry fun result =>
                            Aeneas.Std.uncurry fun after nextPlatform =>
                              Inv
                                  (Itasca.Store.installCode oldCode before.instances.length
                                    (Itasca.Compiler.sourceFunctions raw))
                                  after ∧
                                Itasca.Store.MetadataExtended before after ∧
                                  Extend_store (Itasca.Representation.decodeStore view oldCode before)
                                      (Itasca.Representation.decodeStore view
                                        (Itasca.Store.installCode oldCode before.instances.length
                                          (Itasca.Compiler.sourceFunctions raw))
                                        after) ∧
                                    Itasca.Integration.InstantiationSourceOutcome view oldCode
                                      (Itasca.Store.installCode oldCode before.instances.length
                                        (Itasca.Compiler.sourceFunctions raw))
                                      before module imports raw platform result after nextPlatform)

declarations.name: Itasca.code.validate_body_with.trace
declarations.statement:
∀ {V : Type} (visitor : Itasca.code.OpVisitor V) (observe : V → List Itasca.Visitor.Trace.Observation),
  Itasca.Visitor.Trace.Records visitor observe →
    ∀ (data : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (env : Itasca.metadata.Env) (ctx : Itasca.code.Context)
      (index : Aeneas.Std.U32) (v v' : V) (result : Itasca.Visitor.Trace.BodyResult),
      Itasca.code.validate_body_with visitor data env ctx index v = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (result, v') →
        ∃ observations,
          observe v' = observe v ++ observations ∧ Itasca.Body.CallbackTrace.BodyTrace data 0#usize observations result

declarations.name: Itasca.code.validate_body_with.trace_complete
declarations.statement:
∀ {V : Type} (visitor : Itasca.code.OpVisitor V) (observe : V → List Itasca.Visitor.Trace.Observation),
  Itasca.Visitor.Trace.Records visitor observe →
    Itasca.Visitor.Accepts visitor →
      ∀ (data : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (env : Itasca.metadata.Env) (ctx : Itasca.code.Context)
        (index : Aeneas.Std.U32),
        Itasca.CodeEntry.EnvironmentWithinLimits env →
          data.length ≤ ↑Itasca.limits.MAX_FUNCTION_BYTES →
            Itasca.Body.Validated data env ctx.locals index →
              ∀ (v : V),
                ∃ v' observations,
                  Itasca.code.validate_body_with visitor data env ctx index v =
                      Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (), v') ∧
                    observe v' = observe v ++ observations ∧
                      Itasca.Body.CallbackTrace.AcceptedBody data env ctx index observations

declarations.name: Itasca.metadata.validate_module.complete
declarations.statement:
∀ (data : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (raw : Itasca.Binary.Module),
  Itasca.Binary.ModuleEncodingWithinLimits raw ↑data →
    Itasca.Binary.ModuleSignaturesWithinLimits raw →
      Itasca.Module.Elaboration.Elaborates raw (Itasca.Module.Elaboration.moduleOf raw) →
        Module_ok (Itasca.Module.Elaboration.moduleOf raw) →
          Itasca.Module.Elaboration.Restrictions raw →
            ∃ decoded,
              Itasca.metadata.validate_module data = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok decoded) ∧
                Itasca.Module.Elaboration.Matches decoded.env decoded.tail raw

declarations.name: Itasca.stream.CodeBatch.finish.sound
declarations.statement:
∀ {issued : Itasca.Stream.Batch.Issued} {batch : Itasca.stream.CodeBatch},
  Itasca.Stream.Batch.Reachable issued batch →
    Itasca.CodeEntry.Bounds issued.env →
      batch.finish = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok ()) →
        ∃ entries,
          entries.length = ↑issued.num_funcs ∧
            Itasca.Binary.Rep Itasca.CodeEntry.CodeEncoding entries ↑issued.code ∧
              Itasca.Module.Code.EntriesTyped issued.env (↑issued.first_func) entries

declarations.name: Itasca.stream.CodeBatch.validate_all.complete
declarations.statement:
∀ (issued : Itasca.Stream.Batch.Issued) (entries : List Itasca.Binary.Code),
  issued.Bounded →
    entries.length = ↑issued.num_funcs →
      Itasca.Module.Code.EntriesTyped issued.env (↑issued.first_func) entries →
        Itasca.CodeEntry.EnvironmentWithinLimits issued.env →
          Itasca.CodeEntry.Bounds issued.env →
            Itasca.Binary.Rep Itasca.CodeEntry.CodeEncodingWithinLimits entries ↑issued.code →
              ∃ after,
                issued.seed.validate_all = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok after ∧
                  Itasca.Stream.Batch.Reachable issued after ∧
                    after.finish = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok ())

declarations.name: Itasca.stream.CodeBatch.validate_all.spec
declarations.statement:
∀ (issued : Itasca.Stream.Batch.Issued) (batch : Itasca.stream.CodeBatch),
  issued.Bounded →
    Itasca.CodeEntry.Bounds issued.env →
      Itasca.Stream.Batch.Reachable issued batch →
        Aeneas.Std.WP.spec batch.validate_all fun after => Itasca.Stream.Batch.Reachable issued after

declarations.name: Itasca.stream.CodeBatch.validate_all.total
declarations.statement:
∀ (issued : Itasca.Stream.Batch.Issued) (batch : Itasca.stream.CodeBatch),
  issued.Bounded →
    Itasca.CodeEntry.Bounds issued.env →
      Itasca.Stream.Batch.Reachable issued batch →
        ∃ after, batch.validate_all = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok after ∧ Itasca.Stream.Batch.Reachable issued after

declarations.name: Itasca.stream.validate_streaming.complete
declarations.statement:
∀ {S V : Type} (source : Itasca.stream.Source S) (visitor : Itasca.stream.StreamingVisitor V)
  (config : Itasca.stream.Config) (Queued : Aeneas.Std.U64 → List Itasca.Stream.Batch.Issued → V → Prop),
  Itasca.Stream.Scheduler.Accepts visitor config Queued →
    ∀ (id : Aeneas.Std.U64) (state : S) (before : V) (storage : Itasca.metadata.Env)
      (data : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (raw : Itasca.Binary.Module),
      Itasca.Binary.ModuleEncodingWithinLimits raw ↑data →
        Itasca.Binary.ModuleSignaturesWithinLimits raw →
          Itasca.Module.Elaboration.Elaborates raw (Itasca.Module.Elaboration.moduleOf raw) →
            Module_ok (Itasca.Module.Elaboration.moduleOf raw) →
              Itasca.Module.Elaboration.Restrictions raw →
                Itasca.Stream.Source.CanonicalAvailable source state data →
                  Queued id [] before →
                    ∃ env after deliveredTail,
                      Itasca.Stream.TailDelivery visitor deliveredTail after ∧
                        Itasca.stream.validate_streaming source visitor id state before storage =
                            Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (), after, env) ∧
                          Itasca.Module.Elaboration.Matches env deliveredTail raw ∧
                            Itasca.Module.Elaboration.AccessorTypes env raw ∧ Queued id [] after

declarations.name: Itasca.stream.validate_streaming.sound
declarations.statement:
∀ {S V : Type} (source : Itasca.stream.Source S) (visitor : Itasca.stream.StreamingVisitor V)
  (Tracks : Aeneas.Std.U64 → List Itasca.Stream.Batch.Issued → V → Prop),
  Itasca.Stream.Scheduler.Provenance visitor Tracks →
    ∀ (id : Aeneas.Std.U64) (state : S) (v v' : V) (storage env : Itasca.metadata.Env)
      (data : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8),
      Itasca.Stream.Source.Describes source state data →
        Tracks id [] v →
          Itasca.stream.validate_streaming source visitor id state v storage =
              Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (), v', env) →
            ∃ deliveredTail,
              Itasca.Stream.TailDelivery visitor deliveredTail v' ∧
                Itasca.Module.Sound.Validated data { env := env, tail := deliveredTail } ∧
                  data.length ≤ ↑Itasca.limits.MAX_MODULE_BYTES

declarations.name: Itasca.stream.validate_streaming.total
declarations.statement:
∀ {S V : Type} (source : Itasca.stream.Source S) (visitor : Itasca.stream.StreamingVisitor V)
  (moduleId : Aeneas.Std.U64) (state : S) (v : V) (storage : Itasca.metadata.Env),
  Itasca.Stream.Source.CallbacksTotal source state →
    Itasca.Stream.Scheduler.CallbacksTotal visitor →
      ∃ r, Itasca.stream.validate_streaming source visitor moduleId state v storage = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok r
